title: Autonomous Atmospheric Infrastructure

derived_daily_balance.basis: 2 H2O -> 2 H2 + O2; ideal stoichiometry; no real-system losses

sabatier_ideal_limit.note: Ideal stoichiometric upper bound using all hydrogen from the reference water-electrolysis flow; not demonstrated system performance.

oxygen_buffer_scenarios.status: A-01 planning scenarios, not NASA reserve requirements

mre_demonstration_reference.warning: The 24-hour extrapolation is arithmetic only. The demonstration did not establish continuous operation, lunar deployment, qualified output purity, or a rated production capacity.

water_recovery_reference.note: ISS benchmark; not an assumed lunar-system performance guarantee.

required_load_groups: oxygen separation, purification, drying and compression
habitat air circulation and humidity control
power_budget.reason: Cited public NASA abstracts identify modelling work but do not supply validated AIR-01 subsystem power values.

evidence_gaps: MRE continuous duty, degradation and maintenance
MRE product-gas impurity characterization and breathable-gas qualification
validated mass, power and thermal budgets
water source and lunar ice prospecting evidence
CO2 reduction beyond the hydrogen-limited Sabatier fraction
integrated long-duration testing and fault-injection results
